deviations.description: The intake-audit skill's memory/artifact APIs were unavailable in this Codex App surface; repository and frozen external evidence were used instead.
The legacy top-level delivery doctor lacks a colocated _runtime_truth.py, while the installed skill copy contains it; recorded as a legacy packaging fact.
Legacy doctor baseline capture created one __pycache__ file. It was removed as exact restorative cleanup and the frozen 40-file baseline was reverified with zero mismatches or extras.
The system temporary pytest directory was not writable; tests used a repository-local base temp directory.
Frozen CQC tests ran from a disposable copy to avoid historical tests writing into the frozen checkout; 100 passed and one skipped.

The first bounded smoke attempt used invalid nonnumeric IDs and failed before network or scientific execution. IDs were corrected, a hermetic construction test was added, the complete validation was rerun, and source was refrozen at ac3494d4523630ef4e3226832c43694df4ee5b36.
A fixed build timestamp was used to make the two RC archives deterministic and byte-identical.

The repository RC record cannot contain the SHA of the commit containing itself. The exact audit-only bundle SHA and its CI closure are reported in the external RC_RELEASE_RECORD.json after commit and push.
